summary: Build supplier scorecards, KPI reviews, and corrective action plans in this 5-day intermediate course. Enroll with TrainingCred today.
lede: Supplier relationship management and performance scorecard training covers supplier evaluation and governance for procurement professionals. Participants learn to segment suppliers, select and weight KPIs, design scorecards aligned with service-level agreements, and use risk indicators to prioritize reviews. They also practice preparing supplier review agendas, corrective action plans, and executive dashboards, with an introduction to digital reporting workflows and AI-assisted analytics for spotting trends.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage suppliers, review performance data, and prepare governance reports. It fits you if your role involves supplier scorecards, SLA monitoring, corrective action follow-up, or executive reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be comfortable working in spreadsheets or a procurement reporting template. A current supplier list, KPI report, SLA summary, or scorecard example will help you apply the exercises to your own environment.
